tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: App background behind docked panels and the ribbon.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Docked panels, floating windows (jog pendant), menus, cards.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells inside a panel: text inputs, the console, readout groups, tree rows on hover.

tokens.name: viewport
tokens.usage: Ground behind the 3D cell and the camera frame (dark value is the app's FrameView fill, rgb 24 26 30). Only overlay tokens and floating surface-raised panels sit on it.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines: panel edges, dividers, table rules. Never the only border of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, toggles, unselected segments and jog buttons: 3:1 on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on surface, surface-raised, surface-sunken and viewport.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Labels, units, secondary metadata and placeholder text on surface, surface-raised, surface-sunken and viewport.

tokens.name: drive
tokens.usage: Primary action (Run), selection, active tab, links. As text on any surface or drive-soft. Light value is the app's Run button blue.

tokens.name: drive-soft
tokens.usage: Selected tree row, active ribbon tab, hover on drive-coloured controls; drive text sits on it.

tokens.name: on-drive
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a drive fill (the Run button's label).

tokens.name: estop
tokens.usage: E-STOP fill only: the latching stop button and the E-STOP banner. Never decorative, never for ordinary errors. Light value is the app's E-STOP red.

tokens.name: on-estop
tokens.usage: Label on an estop fill (4.8:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: FAILED status, fault rows, validation errors, destructive buttons. As text on any surface or danger-soft.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of a FAILED pill and a fault row; danger text on it.

tokens.name: hold
tokens.usage: SAFETY_HOLD status, warnings, CHANGED safety rows, stride or latency over budget. As text on any surface or hold-soft.

tokens.name: hold-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of a SAFETY_HOLD pill and a warning row; hold text sits on it.

tokens.name: hazard
tokens.usage: Safety-yellow fill for the hold banner stripe and the jog deadman bar; text on it is on-hazard.

tokens.name: on-hazard
tokens.usage: Text and stripes on a hazard fill (9.7:1).

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: SUCCEEDED status, OK safety rows, the green 'Driving: trained model' line. As text on any surface or ok-soft.

tokens.name: ok-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of a SUCCEEDED pill and an OK row; ok text on it.

tokens.name: busy
tokens.usage: LOADING status, a brain switch or model load in progress, the training progress fill.

tokens.name: busy-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of a LOADING pill; busy text on it.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: solid 2px ring with a 2px gap, at least 5:1 on every surface including viewport.

tokens.name: mark-src
tokens.usage: Overlay: the object the policy picked as SOURCE (box, SRC tag, cell-tree badge). Same in both themes: it is drawn on camera imagery.

tokens.name: mark-dst
tokens.usage: Overlay: the DESTINATION object (box, DST tag). Same in both themes.

tokens.name: mark-detect
tokens.usage: Overlay: perception boxes and 3D position labels (RT-DETR / RF-DETR).

tokens.name: mark-ocr
tokens.usage: Overlay: OCR label boxes (PaddleOCR).

tokens.name: mark-link
tokens.usage: Overlay: robot skeleton links.

tokens.name: mark-joint
tokens.usage: Overlay: robot skeleton joints and the TCP marker.

tokens.name: axis-x
tokens.usage: X axis in the triad, the gizmo and X readouts' tick. Never alone: always labelled X.

tokens.name: axis-y
tokens.usage: Y axis, labelled Y.

tokens.name: axis-z
tokens.usage: Z axis, labelled Z.

families.display: "IBM Plex Sans Condensed", "IBM Plex Sans", "Arial Narrow", sans-serif

styles.name: screen-title
styles.usage: Workspace names in the ribbon and floating-window titles.

styles.name: panel-title
styles.usage: Docked panel headers, set in capitals: CELL BROWSER, TELEMETRY.

styles.name: status
styles.usage: Run-status words in pills and banners, always capitals: RUNNING, SAFETY HOLD.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Put the red cube on the blue cylinder

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels, tree rows, tabs, toggles.

styles.name: readout
styles.usage: Poses, joint angles, rates: every live number, with its unit in caption.

styles.name: readout-lg
styles.usage: The one headline number per telemetry tile (loop Hz, done probability).

styles.name: code
styles.sample: 12:04:31.208 INFO  engine: RUN [a91f] pick up the green ball

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, pill padding, gap inside a readout group.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between controls in a row; tree indent step; panel header padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Panel body padding; gap between form rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between docked panels' content groups; floating window padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between major regions in a page; section spacing in docs.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Outer margin of full-screen dialogs (preflight, training report).

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Tags (SRC, DST), tree badges, the program-line gutter.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, segmented controls, jog keys.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Docked panels, floating windows, the viewport frame.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Status pills, toggle tracks, the round E-STOP button.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Height of compact controls in dense panels: tree rows, toggles, icon buttons.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default height of buttons, inputs, selects, jog keys.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Run controls and the primary action in a floating window.

tokens.name: estop-size
tokens.usage: Diameter of the E-STOP button; never smaller, always visible.

tokens.name: ribbon-height
tokens.usage: Ribbon: 32px tab row plus a 56px tool row.

tokens.name: statusbar-height
tokens.usage: Bottom status bar.

tokens.name: dock-width
tokens.usage: Default width of the left and right docks (min 260px, max 420px).

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Floating windows over the viewport only (jog pendant, view cube menu). Docked panels use borders, not shadows.

tokens.name: shadow-estop
tokens.usage: The E-STOP button's raised, physical look. Nothing else gets it.

tokens.name: z-dock
tokens.usage: Docked panels and the ribbon.

tokens.name: z-float
tokens.usage: Floating windows over the viewport.

tokens.name: z-menu
tokens.usage: Menus and popovers.

tokens.name: z-banner
tokens.usage: E-STOP and SAFETY HOLD banners: above everything, never covered.
